generation.scope: All finite one-opposite-symmetric windows of opposite rank at most nine admit a finite regularity decision without simple-point hypotheses. The whole regular mixed chart has rank ten and minimum period two. Its quartic Frobenius normal forms and residual groups are explicit, and finiteness is a ternary eigenvector test outside the noncurvilinear local algebra. Its eight-dimensional closure is a divisor in the nine-dimensional half-period component.

open_mathematics: Analyze finite point windows without a known opposite symmetry, the full-rank one-symmetric stratum and positive-dimensional fibers. Complete global component and specialization coverage.
